shoots.assetType: transparent modular growth sprite source sheet for the Trees browser game
shoots.request: Create exactly six isolated terminal-shoot specimens in a 3 by 2 grid ordered Apricot, Cherry, Citrus, Peach, Pear, Plum. Each is a short naturally tapered twig from a clean lower-left attachment base toward the upper-right, with one small fork and two to four species-appropriate young leaves or buds near the tip.
shoots.style: Match the canonical botanical watercolor/gouache tree paintings: natural bark grain, softly irregular painted edges, restrained realistic colors, and no outlines.
shoots.constraints: Genuinely transparent background; six disconnected specimens; continuous wood; large gutters; no fruit, flowers, insects, labels, borders, paper wash, shadows, large limbs, root-like sweeping curves, or detached leaves.

juvenileRoots.assetType: transparent modular juvenile-root progression source sheet for the Trees browser game
juvenileRoots.request: Create eighteen isolated young-root specimens in a 3 column by 6 row matrix. Rows are Apricot, Cherry, Citrus, Peach, Pear, Plum. Columns progress from a first radicle with one tiny lateral, to a longer root with two or three lateral forks, to a compact juvenile fan of four to six fine rootlets.
juvenileRoots.style: Match the canonical botanical watercolor/gouache tree paintings with natural root grain, softly irregular painted edges, restrained species colors, and no outlines.
juvenileRoots.constraints: Every specimen begins at a clean top-center root-collar base and grows downward on genuine transparency. No mature roots, trunk, stems, leaves, seed, soil, stones, shadows, labels, borders, paper wash, halos, or loose fragments.
